face_reason: Generated broad balanced oval, heavy chin, narrow close-set level eyes, low brows, balanced nose and fuller lower lip differ from Palkia long tapered face/high ponytail, Heatran elongated angular red-haired face, Vivillon small softer jaw, Regirock wider open eyes and smiling mouth, Regice compact soft jaw, Registeel sharper tapered jaw. Actual image thumbnails compared; hairstyles and ornaments were mentally excluded in structural comparison.
diversity_comparison: Actual recent images viewed together. Gold colour shared with own combat image, but casual places, activities, garments and poses are distinct.
